releaseTrashedUploads.reason: Bounded mode owns candidate names and scans only one Payload at a time from the current installed trash generation, preserving literal AttachmentUploads parsing and default/missing-workspace behavior. Each native payload, gzip expansion and JSON collector is admitted before materialization and released per row; errors stop deletion. Literal flag-off hydration, live/foreign attachment and ownership checks, storage failure handling and upload-record cleanup remain unchanged. SW132 covers native/warm/reloaded generations, SQL drift, bounded 10x trash scans, large raw/gzip payloads, cancellation and release; SW133 differentially covers actual deletion order/duplicates, own/foreign references and owners, missing/failed objects and detached cancellation.
